about: The slate roof's hand-made pieces (D251, D258, tools/kits): its own modules over the roof pattern's (D290), laid along the roof's lines, each modelled along +X, Y up from what it sits on, Z across, in metres. The covering is about 0.025 m of slate (slate.ron). Its ridge cap is anchored at the middle of its foot, seated on the covering.

rafter.about: A rafter or a ridge beam: squared oak, adzed.

batten.about: A sawn batten across the rafters, one under each course.

ridge.about: Saddle-backed sandstone ridge tiles with a roll along the crest, butted in lime, modelled; unfolded flat so they drape over a ridge or a hip.
